rows.note: This is the all-purpose construction for both “in addition to” and “other than”; context determines whether A is included or excluded.

example.english: Besides you, nobody can help me.
example.traditional: 除咗你之外，冇人幫到我。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 nei5 zi1 ngoi6 mou5 jan4 bong1 dou2 ngo5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for adding something else or saying that there is more in addition.

example.english: I bought bread and, besides, some milk.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 min6 baau1 zung6 jau5 ngau4 naai5

rows.note: Use this colloquial discourse marker when introducing an additional reason or point in an argument.

example.english: Besides, this plan is much cheaper.
example.jyutping: zoi3 gong2 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ping4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for “else” when referring to another option, thing, or place, as in 其他地方 “elsewhere.”

example.english: Besides here, do you want to go anywhere else?
example.traditional: 除咗呢度，你仲想去其他地方嗎？
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 ni1 dou6 nei5 zung6 soeng2 heoi3 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1 maa3
